text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day off, with the Arima Kinen
just around the corner—

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Hello, Trainer!
Let's do an early Christmas!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Are you interested in "Romeo and Juliet"?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so... I ended up going to see a play
together with Fuji Kiseki.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
That was a great play! Even though
I knew the ending, it still made me cry.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—"In a world free of strife,
let us find happiness together from now on."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: “Let's live together forever and ever.”

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"I remember now. This line was so hard!
I practiced it over and over so I could deliver it properly."

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Ah, didn't you know? Back when I was in the children's theater troupe,
I played Romeo once.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I remember how super fired up you were
in that leading role you earned for the first time.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I kept muttering my lines at home non-stop,
and I even got scolded to learn how to switch off!

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, brings back memories. Back then, I never
imagined I'd end up walking the path of racing.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Listening to those nostalgic stories...
we had arrived back at the academy in the blink of an eye.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Thanks for keeping me company today!
It turned out to be a wonderful, early Christmas.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
“—Oh, right!
It's nothing big, but...”

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
With all my daily gratitude.
Thank you as always, Trainer!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Looking at the carefully packaged box—
it appeared to be jewelry.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...Gemstones have their own language, you know.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
"May the bond between you and me never change."
That's the wish I poured into it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Opening the box revealed a small
yet beautifully sparkling diamond necklace.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Of course!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...However, the clasp was quite small and tricky to fasten.
As I fumbled with it—"

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Let me see it.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Fuji Kiseki put it on for me in the blink of an eye.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it really looks great on you.
Still, I'm glad I went with a smaller stone.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
I picked something subtle.
...Because I wanted you to be able to wear it all the time.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Just kidding!
Well then, sweet dreams!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Together with Fuji Kiseki,
we spent an unforgettable day.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, just as I thought.
It really suits you well.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, I'd be glad if you did.
—Now then, so, umm...

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right! They just got some delicious hot cocoa in the vending machine over there.
Want to try some?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: ...No, sorry. Cocoa was a bit too sudden, wasn't it?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Um... that was unexpected.
Time flew by faster than I thought.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
In other words...
would it be okay if we stayed together just a little longer?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Yes, here you go.
It's hot, so be careful.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The hot cocoa Fuji Kiseki recommended
was even sweeter and more delicious than I expected.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: "Thanks for hanging out with me even though you're busy. I just felt like it'd be such a waste not to."
choice_data_list: It made me so happy that you invited me.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Fufu, you really are sweet.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: —Hey, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: When I was little, I could never understand the ending of Romeo and Juliet.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Why did the two of them end up chasing after each other, I wonder?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: I wondered what kind of feeling it must be to wish so desperately that someone didn't exist.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
—Still, I feel like I kind of understand now.
Just how precious a one-of-a-kind existence truly is.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Is it because I've grown up a little,
...or is it because I met you?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Which could it be?
Which one do you think it is?

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text: Ahaha! Just kidding! Well? Did your heart race even a little—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Fuji Kiseki looked at my face
and flashed a mischievous smile.

text_block_list.name: Fuji Kiseki
text_block_list.text:
Well, well? What's the matter, Trainer-san?
Your face is bright red.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
—Together with Fuji Kiseki,
I was able to spend an unforgettable day.
